Surfaces.Contract: Start the caller owner before validation or command construction. Keep it through dispatch, native result inspection, typed conversion and cleanup. Delegated methods borrow it; cache hits and successful calls keep the default failure-only owner.

Boundaries.Contract: Start the caller response owner before script validation and command construction. Borrow retry observation through typed conversion and result disposal; successful calls keep the failure-only lease empty.
Boundaries.Name: script-typed-conversion

Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the SCRIPT caller owner across discovery and every primary. Join all replies and cleanup before consistency validation and one caller final publication.
Boundaries.Name: script-primary-fan-out

Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the enclosing SCRIPT caller owner for target transport retries, reply conversion and disposal. Never publish an independent final target failure.
Boundaries.Name: script-primary-conversion

NonRoutes.Reason: Local value construction, validation, formatting, comparison or state inspection; no command dispatch.
Local value construction, validation, formatting, comparison or state inspection; no command dispatch.
